opportunities.name: NPS: find parks by state and open a park's info page
opportunities.description: On nps.gov, pick a {state} in the 'Find a Park' dropdown, scroll the state's park list, and open the {section} link (Basic Information, Current Conditions, National Heritage Areas, etc.) for a {park}.
steps: Click the 'By State...' dropdown under FIND A PARK
Scroll the state's Parks list to the target park or the By the Numbers sidebar
Click the target link (e.g. Basic Information, Current Conditions, National Heritage Areas)
On the resulting page, click the specific park or area link if needed

instances.values: state=Alaska; opened National Heritage Areas -> Kenai Mountains-Turnagain Arm NHA

opportunities.name: Megabus: track a bus by service number
opportunities.description: On megabus.com, open 'Check my bus', switch to the Service Number tab, enter a {service_number}, pick the matching route, and click Find my bus.
steps: Click 'Check my bus' in the top nav and choose the bus tracker
Type the service number into 'Search by Service Number'

opportunities.name: Resy: book tickets for a special event
opportunities.description: On resy.com, open Special Events & Experiences for a {city}, choose an {event}, set the {ticket_count}, pick a ticket type or time slot, and continue to the Complete Your Reservation dialog.
steps: Open resy.com and set the city in the city selector
Open Special Events & Experiences (via Events or 'See More')
Open the ticket-count dropdown and choose the number of tickets
Click 'Book Now' or the time slot for the desired ticket type
Review the Complete Your Reservation dialog (log in and Reserve Now)
